images.caption: The Baishatun Mazu Pilgrimage is a folk religious ceremony passed down from generation to generation in Baishatun Gongtian Temple in Tongxiao Town, Miaoli County, Taiwan. During the ceremony, the believers and staff carried the Matsu God Sedan on foot across Miaoli County, Taichung City, Changhua County, Yunlin County and other areas, and crossed the Daan Creek, Dajia Creek, Datu Creek, and Zhuoshui Creek. Go to Beigang Chaotian Temple to get incense. In addition to Baishatun Mazu, there was a mountain-side Mazu from the Mazu Palace on the mountainside of Nangangli, Houlong Town, Miaoli County. Back to Tongxiao Xinpu Qiu Maoyuan, the four-seater sedan will be replaced by the eight-seater sedan. After the eight-seater sedan is not allowed to drill the car feet again. The characteristics of Baisha Tun Mazu Jinxiang are that only "starting day", "beacon day" and "return to the palace day" are thrown on the afternoon of December 15th of the lunar calendar. The number of days and routes are not fixed every year. This is what Mazu refers to The bearer travels around the car and walks about 300 kilometers back and forth each year. It is one of Taiwan's most special trekking teams.
